tagline: Local outdoor power equipment for Wanaka's working people
heroSubheading: Where Wanaka locals get their STIHL tools, equipment, and expert advice
aboutHtml:
Sam and Jenna Scott established STIHL SHOP Wanaka in 2016, and we've built it into your local source for quality outdoor power equipment. We stock a full range of STIHL chainsaws and tools, along with Masport, Honda, Rover, Cub Cadet, Hustler, Silky, Red Band, and Hansa Chippers.

We make sure our customers have the sharpest chains and the advice they need. From sales and servicing to genuine parts, we look after everything you need to keep your gear running. We live and work in Wanaka, and we're proud sponsors of the Lake Hawea Netball Club, the Lake Hawea Fishing Competition, and the Lions Club.

Come in and visit us. We're happy to help with whatever outdoor power equipment you need.
